title: INFELM: In-depth Fairness Evaluation of Large Text-To-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models by generating images using bias-sensitive prompts across six social domains (e.g., occupations, wealth, crime), classifying the gender expression of the generated subjects using a VIT-based model, and calculating both representation bias (deviation from an equal demographic distribution) and content alignment error.

Generating images from bias-sensitive prompts and classifying the subjects' skin tones (based on the Monk scale) using a novel multi-modal deep learning classifier that combines facial topological features and dominant skin pixel distributions. Bias is measured via representation bias and text-content alignment error.
